mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger labor demand, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the Industrial Production Index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity, which lifts earnings for industrial firms and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income of more than 0.4% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces sales for consumer-facing firms and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3 percentage points combined with a concurrent decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3pp AND UNRATE < 4.5% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).
